description.value: North Arm Farm is a family-run farm shop and U-Pick operation on Highway 99 in Pemberton, sitting directly on the Sea to Sky cycling corridor between Squamish and the Pemberton Valley. The farm shop carries a rotating selection of fresh seasonal vegetables, fruit sourced from the Okanagan, and house-made goods including soups, meat pies, and preserves. U-Pick strawberries, blueberries, and a fall pumpkin patch round out a distinctly local agricultural experience for passing cyclists.
